_about: Turn budgets per step: the median turns of the 4.14.0 baseline runs (tags 2026-10-24-1901, share 2026-10-24-1927). The report marks a step that goes over with ⚠ — the overhead fit is ~2.4 s per call, so a turn saved is time saved. Lower a budget when a release beats it. Since the build and verify run inside /builder:resume (6.x), its budget is resume + build + verify of that baseline (tags 16+23+13, share 24+45+22); builder:build and builder:verify stay for runs from before.
